text:
maria-cheung: FYI CI -> staging deploys failing during k8s scale-out. Pods that need creds crash on start. Noticed after yesterday's helm sync of infra-config. :eyes:
aj: Which injector are we talking about? sealed-secrets or the vault-env sidecar?
ryan-kim: Looks like vault-env (env-injector) — logs show it refused to inject because secret path isn't on the whitelist ConfigMap.
lisa-ng: Wait we intentionally tightened the whitelist in the helm chart last night for prod only. Maybe the values got applied to staging by accident.
devops-bot: [deploy] infra-config release v2026.03.17-7 promoted to cluster/staging by pipeline-gitops
sre-oncall: Paste the error logs?
ryan-kim: Sure — from env-injector pod: ```2026-03-17T09:12:11Z env-injector ERROR: lookup for secret path "secret/data/ai/gpu-provision" failed: path not allowed by allowed_secret_prefixes configmap: [secret/data/ai/*/prod]```
maria-cheung: That path is used by the GPU provisioner init job to fetch instance credentials (ashamedly, we didn't memoize). If injector refuses, init fails, pod exits -> node never registers -> autoscaler keeps spinning new instances. We're burning credits.
aj: Confirmed in helm values history: chart infra-config.staging was accidentally published with the prod whitelist override. GitOps commit 8a3f4b changed configmap whitelist key.
lisa-ng: Oof. So this is config drift introduced by a manual override in CI job?
ryan-kim: The pipeline has an env var that flips when PR tag contains "hotfix". That conditional block sets cfg.allowedPrefixes to prod list. The test matrix missed a branch.
sre-oncall: Impact: staging GPU pool failed to stabilize, autoscaler loop created ~6 nodes over 40m then scaled down. Cost spike and degraded deploys.
maria-cheung: Hotfix options: 1) revert helm release to v2026.03.16 (quick), 2) patch the ConfigMap to add staging prefix, 3) change injector to fallback to per-namespace vault role (riskier). Thoughts?
aj: Revert -> fastest. I can trigger a rollback. Also add a CI guard to prevent prod-only values from hitting staging.
lisa-ng: +1 rollback then add a test that renders helm values for each environment. We need a warning in the pipeline if allowedPrefixes contains prod token while ENV=staging.
ryan-kim: I'll run kubectl patch in parallel to restore staging prefix to unblock immediate pods: ```kubectl -n infra patch configmap env-whitelist -p '{"data":{"allowed_prefixes":"secret/data/ai/*/staging"}}'```
sre-oncall: If you patch, restart the env-injector daemonset to pick up change: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/env-injector```
aj: Rolling back now. Triggered: deploy-bot reported rollback started 1802501258.
devops-bot: [rollback] infra-config -> v2026.03.16 applied to cluster/staging by aj
maria-cheung: After rollback, a few pods succeeded but one init job still failing with 401 from Vault. Might be separate: token TTL?
ryan-kim: Checking vault auth logs... looks like the app role credential for staging rotated last night and CI didn't pick it up. The injector tries to use old secret.
lisa-ng: So two correlated failures: whitelist drift (helm) + expired app-role secret (rotation). Lucky catch before prod.
sre-oncall: Monitor autoscaler and cloud spend for next 2 hours. Also open a postmortem ticket.
aj: I'll add an enforcement job in gitops pipeline: validate helm values against a schema and run a simple sanitizer that rejects prod prefixes in non-prod envs.
maria-cheung: Also add a canary gate: when chart changes include configmap keys, require manual sign-off for env leakage.
ryan-kim: Quick FYI — I added a short script to the CI that renders values and greps for "prod" in allowed_prefixes; pushed branch ci/guard-whitelist.
lisa-ng: Nice. Please also add an alert rule: if env-injector starts rejecting >5 injections/min in any namespace, page infra oncall.
sre-oncall: Created alert infra-evict-injector-failures -> paging enabled.
maria-cheung: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: rollback confirmed, patch applied, vault token rotation action assigned to ryan. Postmortem ticket TKT-4829. :white_check_mark:
aj: Reactions: :thumbsup:
ryan-kim: Reactions: :rocket:
